MENTOR PROSE (in an answer turn this is a slip; the learner sees only the answer): In Mentor Practice, Logo's spin comes from an expression on its Rotation, not from its keyframes. The expression turns it at a steady 30° every second the whole time, so it never slows down. This check measured about 140° of turn at the most. While the expression is on, it sets Rotation by itself, so Logo's two Rotation keyframes don't do anything.

1. Twirl open Logo's Transform, open the Rotation expression and look at it. It adds the same amount of turn every second and has nothing that slows it down near the end. Changing that isn't something I teach yet.
2. Play it back and watch whether the spin keeps the same speed to the end.

Want to try those, or ask about either step?
